brief: Apply agreed contribution rules while distinguishing consent, documented responsibilities and safe support.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Shared Decisions"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Acuerda, verifica y protege decisiones"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Combine, confira e proteja escolhas"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Apply agreed contribution rules while distinguishing consent, documented responsibilities and safe support.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Retrieve shared-cost rules, legal roles and safe support choices.
instruction.misconception: A contribution rule, account access or family relationship automatically establishes fair consent and legal responsibility.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use the current visible conditions; do not reuse a previous scenario’s answer.

evidence.reasoning: Ari pays the agreed share based on combined income.
Viewing permission does not settle ownership or liability.
The first option identifies a commitment and review time.
Safe support does not require confrontation or blame.
Equal sharing divides the expense by the number of contributors.
Circumstances inform agreement; no split is universally right.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: Retrieve shared-cost rules, legal roles and safe support choices.
